newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aznar sees further rate cuts - agencies.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar sees further rate cuts - agencies.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Wednesday that there would be more declines in interest rates this year given favourable economic expectations, local agencies quoted him as saying.
At the inauguration of a trade fair, Aznar pointed to Spain's economic achievements and said this would allow an increase in employment creation.
The key Spanish money market rate has declined to six percent from nine percent at the start of 1996.
